source_name: ESCO (European Skills, Competences, Qualifications and Occupations)
bulk_download_note: The bulk files are email-gated, so the API was used instead. Version therefore reflects whatever the API currently serves.
licence: not stated on the ESCO download page
redistribution: Derived files are kept local and marked requires_review until the licence is confirmed.
known_limitations: A taxonomy, not Kenyan vacancies or Kenyan worker profiles.
European in origin; Kenyan informal-sector terms are absent and must be added separately with their own provenance.
Skill descriptions are not fetched; only identifiers and labels, which is what matching needs and avoids thousands of extra calls.
